question_variants: fees kab tak jama karni hai
entries.answer_en: The last date for B.Tech second-year semester fee is 30 November 2026.
entries.answer_hi: B.Tech second year ki semester fee ki last date 30 November 2026 hai.

entries.answer_en: A late fine of 100 rupees per day applies after the due date, up to 15 days.
entries.answer_hi: Due date ke baad 100 rupaye roz late fine lagta hai, 15 din tak.

entries.answer_en: Fees are paid online through the college ERP portal under Fee Payment; receipts appear in the portal within one working day.
entries.answer_hi: Fees college ERP portal par Fee Payment section se online bharein; receipt ek working day mein portal par aa jaati hai.

entries.answer_en: End-semester theory exams start on 8 December 2026.
entries.answer_hi: End-semester theory exams 8 December 2026 se shuru hain.

entries.answer_en: Admit cards are available on the ERP portal three days before the first exam.
entries.answer_hi: Admit card pehle exam se teen din pehle ERP portal par mil jaata hai.

entries.answer_en: The seating plan is put up on the notice board of each block and on the ERP portal one day before each exam.
entries.answer_hi: Seating plan har block ke notice board aur ERP portal par har exam se ek din pehle lag jaata hai.

entries.answer_en: Re-evaluation forms are issued by the Exam Cell within 7 days of the result declaration.
entries.answer_hi: Re-evaluation form result aane ke 7 din ke andar Exam Cell se milta hai.

entries.answer_en: Hostel fee for 2026-27 is 95,000 rupees per year including mess, for twin-sharing rooms.
entries.answer_hi: 2026-27 ke liye hostel fee 95,000 rupaye saal hai, mess ke saath, twin-sharing room.

entries.answer_en: Room change requests use Form H-4, submitted at the hostel office within 7 days of allotment.
entries.answer_hi: Room change ke liye Form H-4 allotment ke 7 din ke andar hostel office mein jama karein.

question_variants: hostel kitne baje band hota hai
entries.answer_en: Hostel gates close at 10 pm on weekdays and 11 pm on weekends.
entries.answer_hi: Hostel gate weekdays mein raat 10 baje aur weekend par 11 baje band hota hai.

entries.answer_en: Mess timings are 7:30 to 9 am, 12:30 to 2 pm, and 7:30 to 9 pm.
entries.answer_hi: Mess ka time subah 7:30 se 9, dopahar 12:30 se 2, aur raat 7:30 se 9 baje tak hai.

entries.answer_en: The administrative office is open 9 am to 5 pm, Monday to Friday, and 9 am to 1 pm on Saturday.
entries.answer_hi: Administrative office Monday se Friday subah 9 se shaam 5, aur Saturday 9 se 1 baje tak khula hai.
